about_the_game:
The CAL Particle changed everything! After scientists discovered how to animate the calories in food, a decade of warfare ensued. Eventually, the nations of the world agreed to settle conflict in the CALosseum, and now Combat Chefs from around the world seek fame and fortune by battling with GladiEATers...

GladiEATers is a narrative creature battler that blends top-down JRPG, cooking minigames and 6v6 turn-based creature battles. Follow the stories of seven Combat Chefs as they compete to become champion of the CALosseum, and watch their relationships (and your skills) simmer as you take on roguelike Tournament Mode.

Welcome to the CALosseum!

Seven stories of cooking, conflict, and compassion all lead to the CALosseum: A pun-flinging egg farmer, a monolingual Finnish baker (and his best friend) and at least one secret agent will prove themselves, settle old scores, and maybe even make a few friends along the way.

Master each character's culinary specialties in their playable backstory, then embark on a JRPG journey set off by the events of the tournament. GladiEATers explores what it means to cook and eat in a narrative featuring gorgeous pixel animation, fine art-style detailing, and comic sections from Marvel and DC artist Rosi Kämpe.

Cook Your Team

Chop, boil, bake and fry your ingredients into fighting shape in a snappy series of bite-sized minigames. Each round is a chance to add to your team or evolve your existing fighters into new forms.

Once you're plated up, command your culinary creations in up-to-6v6 turn-based battles! Each lovingly hand-animated GladiEATer has its own set of abilities and synergies, plus unlockable chef powers and seasonings for an extra twist. Do you have what it takes to conquer the CALosseum?

Master the Menu

The story continues and the intensity rises in Tournament Mode! Take on a series of increasingly tough battles and test your skills with spicy run modifiers, character meta-progression, and unlockable special abilities.

GladiEATers features…

  • 7 converging Chef Stories that intertwine into a top-down JRPG adventure

  • 65+ GladiEATers all lovingly rendered in gorgeous pixel artwork

  • Deep turn-based combat, with 200+ unique hand-animated abilities

  • Unique synergies and tactics to explore, with up to 12 GladiEATers in play at once

  • All-you-can-eat endless roguelike mode with sweet and savoury run modifiers and metaprogression

  • Comic artwork by Marvel and DC artist Rosi Kämpe
